The '''Safa Toma Speedway''' was a racecourse located on the [[planet]] [[Serolonis]].<ref name="Episode Guide" /> [[Riot Racing]] events were held there.<ref name="Faster" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The racecourse first appeared in "[[Faster]]," the fourth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''.<ref name="Faster" /> It was released on [[January 18]], [[2023]].<ref name="Airdate">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}}</ref> Concept art of the racetrack was done by [[Clinton Felker]] with the lighting concept of the racetrack done by [[Molly Denmark]]. The racetrack tunnels concept art was done by [[Colas Gauthier]]. The lighting concept of the interior of the racetrack tunnels was also done by Molly Denmark.<ref name="Concept Art">{{SW|url=faster-concept-art-gallery|text="Faster" Concept Art Gallery | The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref>
